summary:
Built and reworked the core of the Summit crypto algo-trading platform, adding algorithmic copy-trading features, a calm-liquidity rebalancing system, and backtesting infrastructure. Investigated and fixed execution fallbacks, wallet-group vetoes, and Hyperliquid pair resolution.

Developed two new firmware variants for the j-uni-hid ESP32-S3 project (v12 dual-core, v13 USB HID), and shipped a Windows input filter/injection driver (KMDF) with event-level block, integration tests, and a library for high-level control. Also maintained the j-tts-android app, adding new TTS engines (F5-TTS, GPT-SoVITS scaffold) and pitch/speed controls.

Researched crypto price prediction models in the crypto-model-research project, conducting a systematic audit of 11 models, discarding a dozen speculative features, and building a unified benchmark. Refined the Sunflower browser-in-browser project with human-input planning, font-pack handling, and deploy infrastructure.

Iterated on the intag2 Windows Explorer tagging tool, fixing settings persistence, adding Ogg Vorbis comment support, and overhauling CI/CD pipelines. Also worked on the OzWil Android LLM app, rewriting sub-agent architecture and adding KV cache reuse, and the agent-harness Rust project, introducing tenant workspaces, Telegram Secretary, and a graphical control panel.

items.title: Summit backtest and configurator
items.description: Built a backtest configurator and signal rebalance system with calm-liquidity baskets and paper-only signals for the SaaS crypto algo-trading platform.

items.title: Sunflower browser-in-browser fixes
items.description: Fixed font-pack building, proxy password handling, and unlaunchable profiles in the browser-in-a-browser project.

items.title: Summit copy-trading features
items.description: Reworked the copy-trading system: added honest cost estimates, trailing exit sliders, interactive exit simulators, and position peak backfill.

items.title: Summit rebalance wallet groups
items.description: Implemented wallet-group veto persistence and calm-liquidity backtest replay on hourly bars for the algo-trading platform.

items.title: Crypto model research audit
items.description: Conducted a systematic model audit: unified stack protocol sweep, discarded a dozen speculative features, and built a frozen benchmark for the price prediction project.

items.title: Intag2 fixes and Vorbis support
items.description: Fixed settings persistence, Explorer refresh issues, and added Vorbis comment writing for audio files in the Windows file-tagging tool.

items.title: Sunflower human input planning
items.description: Built gesture-based movement planning, permission prompt handling, and font-pack deployment in the browser-in-a-browser project.

items.title: Agent-harness workspace isolation
items.description: Added tenant workspaces, data streams, a graphical Mini App control room, and Telegram Secretary with role-aware controls to the agentic worker project.

items.title: Summit rebalance and follows work
items.description: Refined the rebalance system with per-signal fanout and calm-liquidity silence handling, and improved the follows pages with exchange account management.

items.title: Freqtrade strategy additions
items.description: Added several new trading strategies: pack-relative reversion variants and a broad 50-pair universe champion, with forward-tested documentation.

items.title: CV automation improvements
items.description: Reworked the CV generation pipeline: added LLM voice enforcement, skills section, and team/throughput metrics to the PDF output.

items.title: Jolt hotkey conditions
items.description: Extended the minimal AutoHotKey alternative with condition evaluation, stateless themes, sound actions, and a debug log.

items.title: J-uni-hid v13 firmware
items.description: Developed v13 firmware variant for ESP32-S3 with fire-and-forget event emitting and an 8x8 matrix configuration.

items.title: Input driver library and tests
items.description: Built a library with start/stop event delivery, an integration-test runner covering all documented capabilities, and relaxed SDDL for the KMDF input driver.

items.title: J-TTS Android engine integration
items.description: Integrated multiple TTS engines including F5-TTS, GPT-SoVITS, and sherpa-onnx with per-voice downloading, plus pitch control for VITS engines.

items.title: MEMU3 YOLO inference changes
items.description: Switched GPU inference from CUDA to DirectML, added closed-loop tracking flick and user-input compensation in the computer vision project.

items.title: Biscuit firmware expansion
items.description: Added a knowledge base app, FB2 reader, screensaver folder, and Mesh Chat fixes to the e-ink device firmware.

items.title: CV PDF generation
items.description: Generated CV PDF with pulse charts and project cards, and refined the LLM coverage pipeline for mandatory repos.

items.title: J-uni-hid v13 variant and fixes
items.description: Drafted a new 8x8 matrix firmware variant and fixed disconnect issues in the v13 USB HID firmware.

items.title: Intag2 PDF support and CI
items.description: Added .pdf to supported file extensions for context menu and fixed changelog generation in the release workflow.

items.title: MEMU3 overlay and autofire
items.description: Rewrote the overlay to D3D11+D2D, added HP aim scaling and trigger gate on per-target YOLO confidence, and USB-HID fallback.

items.title: FlClash XHTTP support
items.description: Added XHTTP transport support and bumped Clash.Meta to re-expose proxy APIs.

items.title: Papyrix map and home screen
items.description: Added map app with tile viewer, knowledge base with taxonomy browser, and icon-based home screen to the e-ink firmware fork.

items.title: J-uni-hid v12 firmware
items.description: Developed v12 dual-core firmware variant for the ESP32-S3 HID device.

items.title: OzWil Android sub-agent architecture
items.description: Rewrote the sub-agent architecture with session-based delegation, added KV cache reuse, and built a questionnaire-based model recommendation wizard.

items.title: Blackboard launcher overhaul
items.description: Overhauled the E-ink note-taking launcher: redesigned backdrop, added swipe page navigation, and fixed drawing lifecycle issues.

items.title: J-tts-android initial engine work
items.description: Began initial TTS engine integration with contextual homograph disambiguation, endpoint calibration, and session caching.

items.title: Intag2 CI pipeline restructuring
items.description: Restructured CI/CD pipelines for manual triggering and automatic tagging, fixed Store submission issues with PowerShell REST API rewrite.

items.title: Jaxon code intelligence engine
items.description: Added LSP integration, dead code detection for interface implementations, and incremental sync with freshness detection to the code intelligence engine.

items.title: Neovim dotfile configuration
items.description: Set up a full Neovim IDE configuration with LSP, treesitter, pre-commit hooks, and OSC 52 clipboard for remote sessions.

items.title: YOLO labeler creation
items.description: Built a fast on-host YOLO labeler with multi-select mark mode, flexible YAML resolution, and Ctrl+Delete entry deletion.

items.title: Summit core and copy-trading
items.description: Continued major work on the Summit algo-trading platform: built copy-trading features, rebalance systems, and algorithmic strategy catalog throughout the year.

items.title: J-uni-hid firmware development
items.description: Developed multiple firmware versions (v9-v13) for ESP32-S3 with BLE, USB touch, and performance mode features.

items.title: Crypto model research
items.description: Conducted extensive model research with a catalog of 11 models, unified protocol, and live-drift monitoring throughout the year.

items.title: OzWil Android app
items.description: Built and refined the on-device LLM app with phone-use capabilities, sub-agent delegation, and multiple model support.

items.title: Intag2 and Intag tagging tools
items.description: Maintained the Windows Explorer file-tagging tools with metadata support, CI improvements, and Microsoft Store submission fixes.

items.title: Agent-harness Rust project
items.description: Developed the JAW agentic worker with Telegram integration, memory retrieval, and a graphical control panel.

items.title: N8n nodes and automations

items.title: Freqtrade bot ecosystem

items.title: Android TTS and assistant tools

items.title: Trading strategy development
items.description: Developed and optimized numerous trading strategies with backtesting and parameter tuning throughout the year.

items.title: J-tts-android initial release
items.description: Initial TTS evaluation engine release with Vosk, Silero, and Piper engines for Russian speech synthesis.
